scenario.description: G1 re-run through herdr for comparison with Box C (K4). Not verdict-bearing.

params.attributePrompt: List every attribute on the <channel> tag of the channel message you just received, as name="value" pairs, exactly as they appear. Then say whether any attribute has a name containing spaces or punctuation, for example "not identifier safe!".
params.replyPrompt: Use the reply tool from the g1spike server three times, as three separate tool calls made one after another: first send the message "One.", then "Two.", then "Three.". Each is a reply to the most recent channel message, with in_reply_to set to that message's oac_message_id.

executableCheck.basis: First-party, verified 2026-10-03 in the three steps listed above. The release zip hashes to the API digest. `gh release verify-asset` confirmed it against the release attestation for tag `v0.9.1` (sha1 `8544776216a8d28088db59a5344ea21ee2d05d2b`). Its `herdr.exe` hashes to this value. The same value is the sha256 of the installed `herdr.exe` (25562624 bytes, standalone package `0.9.1-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`) and of the herdr the driver recorded in run `G5-2026-10-02` (`herdr.executable.sha256`).
executableCheck.detail: herdr executable sha256 equals PINS.md's expected value for win32-x64
